lines.text: Ship 42 completed its third cryo proof test.
Two back-to-back cryo proof tests.
Booster 22 completed its first full cryo proof test.
Ship 42 ready with all 6 Raptors.
Booster 22 ready with all 33 Raptors.
Ship 42 fired all 6 Raptors.
Ship 42 fired 1 Raptor.
Booster 22 completed a full-duration 33-engine static fire.
Ship 42 released from the Pad 2 chopsticks after its tests.
Chopsticks lifted Ship 42 to catch height, and its quick-disconnect arm connected several times.
Pad 2 chopsticks lifted Ship 42 without the stabiliser arms.
Chopsticks lifted Booster 22 off the launch mount to catch height.
Pad 2 booster quick disconnects purging, likely ahead of Booster 22.
More catch tests at the tower top, plus launch and landing deluge tests.
Pad 2 launch mount service structure removed.
Catch testing with the Pad 2 chopsticks at the top of the tower.
Pad 2 chopsticks under maintenance.
Pad 2 cleared after Flight 14, with a new service structure going in.
On SpaceX's Q3 call, Elon said Flight 15 is next month and will try to catch both vehicles.
Reports say Flight 15 is targeting NET 8 November.
A slide suggests Ship 42 is ready for flight NET November.
Both vehicles could be flight-ready by the end of October.
An air-traffic slide shows a very provisional NET 19 October.
